name: azulejeria
description: Pattern by rule, painted to look like a material. A seeded canvas engine that began with Spanish azulejo walls: tiles with a drifting brush, the seventeen wallpaper groups and the seven frieze groups, a tile cutter, interlace, a hand-drawn tile, cast shadows, a loom and knitting.
author: Andy Cross
